authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full vāta wind and its Old Marwari vāi addendum support Jaunsari bat/bāt with retained stop and Bhilali vāi with loss of the stop. Turner notes that vāta and vāyu are not always distinguishable in NIA; the vāi link follows the explicit Old Marwari comparison provisionally, not a resolved exclusive ancestry. Exact response: bat.
